props.gloss_en: RSbG (mishna): two guests eat on one table, this one meat and that one cheese, and they need not be concerned
Shmuel: they taught this only when they do not know each other
Shmuel: but if they know each other, it is forbidden

RSbG (baraita): two guests who lodged at one inn, this one come from the north and that one from the south, this one come with his piece [of meat] and that one with his cheese, eat on one table, this one meat and that one cheese, and need not be concerned
RSbG (baraita): and they forbade only in one parcel
(entertained, and dropped) the clause means literally one parcel
rather, [the clause means] like one parcel

Abaye: shall they say 'all the decorated cakes are forbidden, and the decorated cakes of Baitos are permitted'?!

Mar bar Rav Ashi: his belt proves for him
